verdict.rationale: Ledgy has a documented API with named operations such as auth, companyCaptable and companyTransactions, so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair question. No evidence shows one is published, and probes of the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The OAuth authorization-server metadata endpoint describes authentication only, not the API, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
